a: The cell is the basic unit of life.
DNA stores genetic information in a double helix.
RNA helps express genetic information, including as messenger RNA.
Proteins are polymers of amino acids that do most cellular work.
Mitosis divides a cell's nucleus into two identical nuclei.
Meiosis produces gametes with half the chromosome number.
Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy in plants.
Cellular respiration releases energy from food molecules.
Evolution is change in heritable traits of populations over generations.
An ecosystem includes living organisms and their physical environment.
